browserdevice.title: Browser device
browserdevice.intro: The browser tab is the device: its volume, location, camera and power. These settings are what the tab starts with.
browserdevice.camera.hint: The browser still asks before the camera opens.
browserdevice.volume.hint: The first time only; after that the tab keeps the volume you left it at.
browserdevice.sensors.intro: Battery, network, screen, storage, memory and CPU are always reported: the browser tells them without asking. The sensors below ask on the device, so each is off until you turn it on.
browserdevice.sensors.tap: Someone must tap “Allow” on the device's screen.
browserdevice.s.position.hint: Where the device is, over time. The browser asks.
browserdevice.s.presence.hint: Whether someone uses the device, and whether its screen is locked (Chrome). The browser asks.
browserdevice.s.mic_level.hint: How loud the room is, in dB. The browser asks for the microphone.
browserdevice.s.motion.hint: Acceleration, rotation and the magnetic field. Asks on iPhone and iPad.
browserdevice.state.waiting: Waiting for a tap on the device
